interpretations: For each patient ID in `Laboratory`, average its non-NULL `HGB` values; compare that average with the average of all non-NULL `HGB` lab records pooled across patients; keep only patients above the pooled average; return each kept patient’s ID, average HGB, excess over the pooled average, and excess over the mean of the kept patients’ averages; sort by the last value descending and return the first 10 rows without rounding.
queries:
WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS average_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
pooled_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(HGB) AS average_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
),
kept AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.average_hgb, p.average_hgb - a.average_hgb AS excess_over_pooled
    FROM patient_averages AS p
    CROSS JOIN pooled_average AS a
    WHERE p.average_hgb > a.average_hgb
)
SELECT
    ID,
    average_hgb,
    excess_over_pooled,
    average_hgb - (SELECT AVG(average_hgb) FROM kept) AS excess_over_kept_mean
FROM kept
ORDER BY excess_over_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
